rationale: The candidate reads coherently in all four views as one dominant continuous ring/plate with a single large central void, so it avoids the fragmented or single-view-only failure. The open court is legible, spatially consistent across views, and the long low profile supports the gymnasium brief better than a vertical or cascading object would. The roof/section is simple but still compatible with a long-span hall datum; the central void and perimeter thickness give it a public, court-like character. It does not collapse into a generic box, and the visible hierarchy is clear: perimeter mass as the main body, void as the organizing center. The main weakness is that the roof expression is fairly restrained and could better articulate span/daylight, but it remains program-plausible and structurally coherent at this stage.
